description: Stay focused , attentive and shooting for accuracy, #selflove #flexibility #selfcare
transcript: I look at everything through a mental, physical, and spiritual lens, and that allows me to get a broad perspective of everything that's going on around me. Looking through those three lenses allows me to stay attentive, focused, and always shoot for accuracy. I take my life very, very personal, everything that I do matters. I see reality for what it is, not what I wish it to be, and that allows me to maneuver accordingly. That keeps me in a constant state of flexibility. That keeps me in a constant state of being aware of the way in which I'm responding to situations.
